8. In the adjacent picture -
(i) $\angle DAC$ is an angle of depression
(ii) $\angle ACB$ is an angle of elevation
(iii) $\angle DAC = \angle ACB$

Which one of the following is correct?
1) $i$ and $ii$ 2) $ii$ and $iii$ 3) $i$ and $iii$ 4) $i, ii$ and $iii$

9. What is the other name is of geoline?
1) perpendicular line 3) Lying line
2) Parallel line 4) Vertical line
10. If the angle of the elevation of the top of the miner is $30^\circ$ at a point on the ground and the height is 26 metre, then find the distance of the plane from the Miner.
11. If the top of a tree is 20 metre distance from the foot on the ground at any point on the ground and the angle of elevation is $60^\circ$, find the height of the tree.
12. Forming $45^\circ$ angle with ground an 18 metre long ladder touches the top of the wall, find the height of the wall.
13. If the angle of depression at a point on the ground 20 metre from the top of the house is $30^\circ$, then find the height of the house.
14. The angle of elevation of a tower at any point on the ground is $60^\circ$. If moved back 25 metre, the angle of elevation becomes $30^\circ$, find the height of the tower.
15. The angle of elevation of a tower becomes $60^\circ$ from $45^\circ$ by moving 60 metre towards a minar. Find the height of the minar.

16. A man standing at a place on the bank of a river observed that the angle of elevation of a tower exactly opposite to him on the other bank was $60^\circ$. Moving 32 metre back he observed that the angle of elevation of the tower was $30^\circ$. Find the height of the tower and the width of the river.
17. A pole of 64 metre long breaks into two parts without complete separation and makes an angle $60^\circ$ with the ground. Find the length of the broken part of the pole.
